rules.statement: An action for breach of warranty of title arising from an implied contract can be brought within six years if the vendor had no shadow of a title to the property sold, even without formal notice of legal proceedings resulting in eviction.
rules.supporting_quote: I am unable to agree with that contention. Section 7 appears to me clearly to relate to a case where the agreement or promise or contract or bargain, the breach of which is complained of, was reduced to writing. Now, in this case, the contract to warrant the property sold was not reduced to writing: it is implied from the fact of there being a contract of sale.
